title: C. Pōja Verdon
statement:
Aenar has an array a consisting of n integers.

The first line is the integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 100).

The second line contains n integers a_i (0 ≤ a_i ≤ 3979) — the contents of the array.

Output a single number.
input:
The first line is the integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 100).

The second line contains n integers a_i (0 ≤ a_i ≤ 3979) — the contents of the array.
